review:
A classic 40-line fruit slot with a mysterious queen. Three Joker Queens on reels 2, 3 and 4 start the main feature.

That opens a run of respins where the queen expands and stays wild on her reels the whole time, hitting lots of lines. One clear, recurring feature – nothing complicated. Medium-high volatility, a fairly low 1,172x cap and 95.87% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
